According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is making large-scale adjustments to its retail stores to pave the way for its upcoming home product line. Apple is expected to launch the next-generation HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this autumn, but from various signs, it seems a third, more important product is also poised for release.

Apple has accumulated a large backlog of home products waiting to be released, mainly because the engineering work on the revamped Siri has been delayed multiple times. Now that the Siri overhaul has finally been completed, the market can finally look forward to the official debut of these new products after years without updates.

Previous reports indicated that Apple would launch the new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K first, while the company's first smart home hub (also referred to by the outside world as a HomePod with a display, or HomePad) might arrive later.

However, based on the direction of the retail store preparations, this smart home hub is expected to launch alongside the new Apple TV and HomePod mini. The following is an excerpt from the Power On newsletter:

Of course, everything will only be revealed at Apple's event in September. But based on current reports, we may see Apple unveil its all-new smart home hub in the near future, together with the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini supporting Siri AI.

Summary

Based on various reports, the Apple smart home hub will feature a 7-inch square display and come in two versions: one with built-in speakers, and the other with a magnet built into the back for easy wall mounting. The product will run a brand-new operating system, with a home screen that supports widgets, can be used for FaceTime calls, and serves as the hub for all smart home accessories and Siri. On the hardware side, it will be equipped with the A18 chip.

Another new rumor regarding Apple's home product line is that the next-generation Apple TV 4K may come with a redesigned Siri Remote, although the specific changes are not yet clear.

Are you interested in the new home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
